Well first of all, don't try to do 4 hours.

Try small goals; Sit for 10 minutes regularly. Try to keep your mind clear of thoughts about your chores. For some people it helps to focus on breathing, but it can be detrimental (don't count sheep, you are not trying to fall asleep).
